instruction: Candid full shot of a couple jumping on a white mattress in a pine forest. On the left, the woman in the light blue short-sleeved shirt and shorts (R1) jumps with bent knees, smiling in profile. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt and light blue pants (R2) jumps with legs spread, laughing. They face each other, holding both hands. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the natural green and brown forest tones against the white bedding.
